notes.title: "Star Shift: Rebellion" Has Launched!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the next chapter in the Star Shift Saga, "[b]Star Shift: Rebellion[/b]," has been launched! Now's your chance to pick up a copy of your own! Launch the Rebellion from your PC!

[previewyoutube=LGeaASEtfK8;full][/previewyoutube]

Infernis Prime: a mining colony on the edge of the Outer Rim, languishes under a brutal occupation. Within the shadows of this forsaken world, a spark of hope flickers. With the help of a hacked android and the discovery of a dark secret, the seeds of the future take root. "Star Shift: Rebellion" unfolds with the gripping tale of the Outer Rim Coalition's formation and their quest for liberation.

[b]The Saga Begins:[/b] Today, you are invited to step into a universe where the fabric of reality is not what it seems, and the line between right and wrong blurs with each revelation. Will you rise as the beacon of hope in a galaxy consumed by darkness? Or will you forge a path of power, regardless of the cost? The legacy of "Star Shift: Rebellion" is not written in the stars but by the hands of those brave enough to take the helm.

[b]Chart Your Course: [/b]Beyond the rebellion, beyond the fight for freedom, lies the truth to alter the course of history. Engage in strategic combat that challenges both your intellect and your resolve. Navigate alliances, uncover secrets, and make decisions that will define the legacy of the Outer Rim Coalition.

The universe of "Star Shift: Rebellion" awaits. Are you ready to uncover the truth, join the fight, and lead the rebellion? Chart Your Course: [b]Join the Rebellion Today![/b]. 

[h2]Epic Space Opera Storyline:[/h2]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/epic-space-opera-storyline.gif[/img][/url]

- Time has been shattered. Only you and your crew can unlock the mystery before it's too late!

[h2]Strategic Turn-Based Combat:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/Strategic-Turn-Based-Combat-SSR.gif[/img][/url]

- A Mashup of tactical RPG and turn-based strategy elements... with a sci-fi twist!

[h2]Tactical Fleet Combat:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1824040/Star_Shift_Rebellion/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1824040/extras/tactical-fleet-combat.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]A Diverse Cast Of  Playable Characters:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41524194/13bc9dc3e1658c234d7e3d16e3aabf2ab889626a.png[/img]

-A diverse cast of playable characters with unique skill trees to complement your play-style.

[h2]Complex Skill Tree System:[/h2]

notes.title: Star Shift at Steam NextFEST - Development
notes.content:
Join us here at the specified time and watch us develop the game in real time:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561197993622894]https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561197993622894[/url]

[previewyoutube=CcmQQi_Cpb0;full][/previewyoutube]

The year is 2357. Humans have explored the stars and colonized many worlds under the authority of the Earth Systems Alliance (ESA), a government controlled by powerful interstellar organizations. An alliance in name only, it is in reality, a brutal empire.

The Earth Systems Alliance (ESA) is embroiled in a civil war with a faction known as the Novus Federation. They are made up of former ESA colonists, corporations and military personnel who oppose Alliance rule and actively undermine ESA activities.

Both sides have committed war crimes on civilian populations. This has destabilized the balance of power in the region, creating chaos.

FEATURES:

- Tactical Battle System (Fleet/Army battles)
- Over 100 playable characters
- Epic Space Opera Storyline
- Branching story arcs
- Over 100 hours of Gameplay
- Base/Empire building
- Active Time Battle System
- Multiple side-quests/short stories
- Starship and human combat
- Class/Job System with trainable skills
- Amazing soundtrack from various independent artists

notes.title: Star Shift Updated to Version 0.6!
notes.content:
Star Shift has been updated to 0.6. This is a big update that makes many changes to the core gameplay. Version 0.6 comes with a complete graphical overhaul, as well as the addition of a new skill tree system which allows the player to learn skills from various disciplines in the order they choose. 

[previewyoutube=3T8wFcQrdnk;full][/previewyoutube]

New stories have been added including the latest story which is a crossover story between Star Shift and Killer Gin (another game). Here is a sample of that crossover story, added to this latest version of the game. 

[previewyoutube=YZF4GKZ7XbI;full][/previewyoutube]

CHANGELOG:
1. Rebalancing change
2. Massive Graphical Overhauls
3. Storyline Additions
4. Various bug fixes
5. Class change system replaced with Skill Tree System
6. Mercenary Class replaced with Rogue Class. 
7. Tactical Combat performance improvement
8. Tactical combat transitioned from single units to armies.

notes.title: Star Shift 0.39 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to everybody who has alpha tested our game so far. A number of small bugs have been brought to our attention and they are now patched with this update. 


1. First level being too hard.
2. Items not disappearing when used in battle.
3. Addition of item drops for enemies.
4. Walking through walls on certain maps.

As a workaround for now, if you experience combat balancing difficulties, there's a difficulty slider in the options menu. 

Version 0.4 will be coming out in a few weeks and will have many more improvements added. The 0.39 build fixes the biggest 0.38 bugs.

Thank You,
Psychronic Game Studios

notes.title: Star Shift 0.38 Update!
notes.content:
Star-Shift has been updated to version 0.38. This update adds many fixes to the core gameplay. This video shows a basic introduction and early gameplay of the game. If interested, please check it out. The demo on Steam is about 3 hours of early gameplay. The full game will be much longer, but will give you the basic feel/concept of the game. 

[b]Change Log:[/b]

- Added Class/Job System with trainable skills
- Additional storyline and side-quests
- Improvements to the tactical battle system
- More tactical battles
- Added base building/outpost
- More random ships living in each solar system/doing things
- Additional shops/items/weapons/armor
- Combat balancing changes
- Various lag improvements
